_: Declared quality gates for this project — the thresholds every actor (any agent, any tier, any human) must clear, held by quality_ratchet.py. STARTS EMPTY ON PURPOSE: a ratchet begins where the project IS, not where an article says it should be. Measure first, then declare each gate at its current value; `python3 quality_ratchet.py --run` reports every gate, and `install-hook` makes the pre-commit ratchet refuse any later commit that loosens one. Thresholds only tighten. Loosening one is a plan-mode decision made in its own commit with the reason in the ledger, committed with --no-verify — a recorded bypass, not an exemption (SAFEGUARDS.md Blast Radius Limits; SESSION_RUNNER.md failure mode #17; ITERATIVE_METHODOLOGY.md §Mechanical Gates Bind Every Actor).
_results_file: Where --run writes its results (gitignored by default — add it to .gitignore; the receipt cites the summary line, and the dashboard reads the file where it exists). Commit it instead if you want every clone to score the last run.
_gate_schema: Each gate: `name` (unique; the ratchet keys on it), `direction` (`min`: measured >= threshold, or `max`: measured <= threshold), `threshold` (a number), and optionally `command` (run via the shell from the project root) plus `extract` (a regex whose FIRST capture group is the measured number; without `extract` the command's exit code is the measurement, so `max 0` means `must exit 0`). A gate with no command is declared, not measured: --run reports it UNMEASURED and exits 1 — never pass. `why` and `unit` are free text for the reader.

_example.name: coverage
_example.why: measured 82.5% on 2026-01-01; a floor without a faithfulness check beside it measures effort, not quality — pair it with a mutation spot-check in review

gates.name: tarball_size_clean_export
gates.unit: bytes (decimal MB, the S727 audit's currency; CRAN guideline is 10 MB)
gates.command: X=$(mktemp -d) && mkdir "$X/src" "$X/out" && git archive HEAD | tar -x -C "$X/src" && Rscript -e "cat(sprintf('TARBALL_BYTES=%.0f', file.size(pkgbuild::build('$X/src', dest_path = '$X/out', quiet = TRUE))))" ; rc=$?; rm -rf "$X"; exit $rc
gates.why: Declared S728 (2026-09-19, owner-approved follow-up from docs/audits/TARBALL_SIZE_AUDIT_2026-09-19.md Finding 5): clean-export build measured 3,485,185 B at f8ffa40b; the gate at 5 MB catches a scratchpad-class leak or runaway growth long before CRAN's 10 MB line. Measures a `git archive HEAD` export (the artifact a fresh clone / CRAN submission gets), never the working tree -- working-tree leaks are the .Rbuildignore/.gitignore hygiene entries' job. Full build with vignettes; ~1-3 min per run, inside the ratchet's 600 s timeout.

gates.why: Declared S1052 (2026-10-24) from docs/audits/PERF_BASELINE_2026-10-24.md: reportGV() on the example as the app trims it (708 rows, 1,000 iterations, threshold 4) took 3.28 s, median of 3 runs (3.27 to 3.38); threshold = the slowest of the 3 runs plus 25%, rounded up to 0.1 s (owner-approved S1052: one gate per later phase, +25% time, +10% memory). Tightened S1053 (2026-10-24, Phase 1, genome uniqueness: one fast rare-allele count, built once): the same run took 0.60 s, median of 3 fresh-process runs (0.60, 0.60, 0.61, at load average 9.5 to 10.4; peak 162.9 to 132.9 MB), so 4.3 s becomes 0.8 s by the same rule (0.61 s plus 25%, rounded up to 0.1 s).
